messages:
maya: Heads-up — we got a customer report (higher-than-normal tail latency + 401s intermittently). They run the SDK with hedged requests enabled and see calls bouncing between us-west and eu-west. Suspect client retry logic + smart-routing fallback causing region-hopping. Posting excerpts.

maya: log snippet from customer:
```
2026-03-15T18:02:12Z INFO request id=abc123 region=us-west status=503 timeout
2026-03-15T18:02:12Z INFO retry->fallback host=eu-west-1.rw-inference.com attempt=1
2026-03-15T18:02:13Z WARN auth token invalidated for key=acct-xxx (401)
2026-03-15T18:02:13Z INFO request id=abc124 region=eu-west status=200 latency=420ms
```

maya: customer says they have per-region auth tokens and the SDK picks a different region on retry so token mismatch triggers 401s. They also see cross-region token billing spikes.

tom: Can you paste the SDK config they're using?

maya: here's the relevant snippet they shared (node):
```
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  regions: ['us-west-2','eu-west-1'],
  hedgedRequests: true,
  timeoutMs: 1000,
  retryBackoffMs: 0
});
```

luke: ah — `retryBackoffMs: 0` + hedging will cause near-simultaneous requests to multiple regions. If their token is region-bound, you'll get auth failures on the secondary. Also causes cross-region latency/billing.

ana: ops-bot just posted that we rolled out a change to smart-routing fallback last week (routing v2.3). Could be more aggressive in falling back to any healthy region. @tom @luke :thinking:

ops-bot: deploy: routing-service v2.3 -> prod at 2026-03-10T04:12Z (canary 10% -> 100%). Related PR: github.com/redwood/routing/pull/482

tom: Repro plan: 1) run the Node SDK with their config against staging routing v2.3 2) enable per-region token enforcement 3) capture sequence of host selection + tokens.

luke: Short-term mitigation for the customer: set `hedgedRequests: false` OR set `retryBackoffMs` to >= 200 and `stickyRegion: true` (we added stickyRegion option in SDK v1.4.2). Also they can attach `X-Region: us-west-2` header to force region affinity.

maya: I suggested they patch to SDK v1.4.2 (contains stickyRegion and token propagation fixes) and set a non-zero backoff. They replied they can test tomorrow.

tom: Longer-term: we should add server-side guard so auth tokens are validated against host region for fallback requests or add a header-based token namespace to avoid accidental cross-region token use. Filing eng ticket.

luke: Filed ENG-1189: "Prevent cross-region auth mismatch on client hedged retries". Notes: add opt-in header `X-Allow-Region-Fallback: true`, server rejects fallback requests that don't present matching region-token unless header enabled.

maya: Customer notified. I'll follow up after their test. For our tracking: assign to @luke, cc @tom, escalate if they still see 401s after SDK patch. :thumbsup:
